interpretation: This analysis was performed as a proposal-aligned sensitivity analysis using a reproducible 70/30 train-test split and LASSO-Cox modelling.
Training-only cross-validation selected four genes at lambda.min: GCLC, EGLN3, DSG2, and CLSPN. lambda.1se selected no predictors.
The four-gene lambda.min model showed apparent training discrimination with C-index 0.657. This estimate is apparent and is not a validation result.
In the untouched held-out test cohort, the continuous LASSO score showed weak discrimination (C-index 0.524) and no significant association with overall survival (p = 0.7).
Using the training-derived median cutoff, held-out high- and low-risk groups showed essentially no survival separation (HR 0.996; log-rank p = 0.989).
Held-out time-dependent AUCs were 0.551 at 1 year, 0.462 at 3 years, and 0.478 at 5 years, indicating limited held-out discrimination.
The simple single-split LASSO workflow did not demonstrate robust prognostic generalization despite selecting a sparse four-gene model in the training cohort.

These findings support retaining the repeated nested-cross-validation ridge MPCDS as the primary prognostic model. Script 33 is a methodological sensitivity analysis and does not replace or invalidate the primary MPCDS framework.
